proof_body:
by
  intro F E _ _ _ _ _
  exact ⟨fun K => IsGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup K, fun H => IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_fixedField H⟩
target_source: ∀ (F E : Type*) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [FiniteDimensional F E] [IsGalois F E], (∀ K : IntermediateField F E, IntermediateField.fixedField K.fixingSubgroup = K) ∧ ∀ H : Subgroup (E ≃ₐ[F] E), (IntermediateField.fixedField H).fixingSubgroup = H
